description: Replan integrity review (#2016). Answers whether a plan change is justified and leaves the upstream contract intact. The previous plan is a required input: without it this is a plan review, not a replan review.

inputs.name: baseline
inputs.description: The plan this one replaces. Required, so its absence stops the Flow.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Upstream requirements the revision must not break. Optional: absence degrades the cross-artifact step.

steps.description: Missing `plan` or `baseline` stops here (both required inputs).
The plan-to-plan delta is the subject of this Flow, so a failure here stops rather than degrades.
Whether the revision changed what the plan means, not only how it is worded.
Revised plan against upstream requirements. Without requirements it degrades to a delta-only review and records the degradation.
